purpose: Continue despite a previously stated obstacle.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
The rain grew heavier. Even so, the game continued.
I failed many times. Even so, I did not give up.
I knew it was expensive. Even so, I wanted to buy it.
restrictions: The preceding situation remains true while the next action or outcome contrasts with it.
mistake: It differs from それなら, which accepts a premise for a next step.

segments.role: Continue despite a previously stated obstacle. Sentence. それでも + sentence.
